'''Chapter 418''' is titled "Luffy vs. Rob Lucci".

==Cover Page==
[[Cover Page#Animal Theater|Animal Theater]]: [[Tony Tony Chopper|Chopper]] and a team of kangaroos train for an upcoming soccer match—using a hapless armadillo as their ball.

==Short Summary==
The fight between [[Monkey D. Luffy]] and [[Rob Lucci]] continues. [[Nico Robin]] tries to slow down her progress to the [[Gates of Justice]]. The rest of the [[Straw Hat Pirates]], [[Franky]], [[Kokoro]], [[Chimney]], and [[Gonbe]] try to catch up with Robin, while everyone else tries to escape [[Enies Lobby]].

==Long Summary==
The chapter starts off with [[Roronoa Zoro]] finishing [[Kaku]]. Zoro then gives him the message [[Paulie]] gave him which is, "You're fired". Kaku manages to joke around a small bit before handing over the key. [[Sanji]] catches up with him, and they both head off to catch up with [[Nico Robin]].

Meanwhile, the giants, carrying the [[Galley-La Company]] foremen, the [[Franky Family]], [[Sodom]] and [[Gomorrah]], are hurrying to try to escape the island before the [[Buster Call]] arrives.

Meanwhile, [[Spandam]] and Robin have finally reached the [[Gates of Justice]]. Robin tries to run away back to the [[Straw Hat Pirates|Straw Hats]], but Spandam keeps telling her she has no hope.

Back to the fight with [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] and [[Rob Lucci]], Luffy is badly hurt. [[Franky]] tries his Strong Hammer move, but Lucci merely uses his [[Six Powers|Tekkai]], which is five times stronger than [[Fukurou]]'s. Lucci then proceeds to beat up Franky. Before he could finish him, Luffy uses [[Gear 2]] and hits Lucci with his [[Gomu Gomu no Mi/Techniques|Gomu Gomu no Jet Pistol]]. Franky is shocked to see such an increase in power. Luffy tells him to go on and catch up to Robin, while he takes care of Lucci, who is now in his [[Neko Neko no Mi, Model: Leopard|human-leopard]] hybrid form. Lucci reminds him that he stabbed Luffy in this form, but Luffy just said that wound healed after he ate some meat. Lucci again uses his [[Six Powers|Shigan]] move, but Luffy dodges and fights back with his Gomu Gomu no Jet Bazooka.

Meanwhile, Spandam manages to shake Robin free and they continue onward. Luffy yells at Franky to hurry up and get Robin. With that, Franky quickly runs off to get her back.
